name: route climbing
description: Climbing routes on a rope, either leading or on top rope. Done as laps or sets of routes, it builds the endurance to keep moving efficiently over many moves.
instructions: Check your knots, harness and belay setup with your partner before every climb.
Choose a route that matches the goal of the session.
Climb at a steady pace, clip calmly and shake out on good holds.
Lower off and rest, or climb the route again straight away for another lap.
Repeat for the planned number of routes or sets.
Note the grade and how pumped you got.
